promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Use case: title logo for the end of a game cinematic. Starsector Marines is a grounded game about a small mercenary marine company of refugees from a failing mining station who arrive on a jungle world in a patched old ship. Direction: hand-painted hull lettering. The mark is the ship's own lettering: STARSECTOR brush-painted by hand in bold, slightly condensed block capitals across a long section of weathered hull plating made of several overlapping patched panels with weld seams and rivet lines, in mismatched faded rust-red, grey and primer tones. The paint is cream white with a hand-painted thin black keyline, sun-faded and scuffed, with a few chips where a panel was replaced and the lettering carries on across it. MARINES is smaller, painted in a simple stencil on a narrow strip below. The hull panel section is the logo shape, cut out with a slightly irregular rectangular silhouette of plate edges; everything outside the panel is transparent. Honest, worn, proud, home-made.

Lettering must be spelled exactly, in capital letters: STARSECTOR, large and dominant, the main word of the title; and MARINES, clearly smaller, as the subtitle that names this particular game. No other words, numbers or letters anywhere. This is an original logo for a fan-made game mod: do not imitate the logo, typeface, layout or emblem of any existing game, studio or franchise, and do not add trademark symbols. True transparent background, including the spaces inside and between letters; no ground, no backdrop, no drop shadow slab, no border, no frame, no mockup, no watermark. Wide landscape canvas. The whole mark centred with generous empty margin around it. Flat-on front view, not in perspective, not on an object. It will be composited over a bright aerial photograph of grey concrete and green jungle, so it needs strong value contrast at its edges and the smaller word must stay legible at a quarter of screen width.
agentMessages: I’ll generate one image with the imagegen skill, using the painted hull-panel lettering and transparent background you described.
